items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I recorded for Harry Lim, made quite a few records for him.

ctx.x: You played on some of the Harry Lim -- Harry Lim used to have like jam sessions, didn't he?

That's right. Jam sessions and of course, I recorded for Harry Lim, made quite a few records for him. I think a few of them we recorded -- that I recorded were with Johnny Guarnieri on piano and what have you.
What kind of -- oh, excuse me. Go ahead.
